title: Cottage cheese with jam
blurb: Cold, quick, high in protein.
method:
Spoon the cottage cheese into two bowls.
Add 2 tbsp jam to each and swirl it in lightly.
Top with berries and granola if you like.

title: Hot ham & cheese sandwich
blurb: Golden, crisp, melted in the middle.
method:
Butter one side of each bread slice.
Build two sandwiches, butter side out: mustard, ham, cheese.
Cook in a pan over medium heat with a lid on, 3–4 min per side, until golden and the cheese melts.
Cut diagonally and serve hot.

title: Peanut butter & jelly open sandwich
blurb: Toasted bread, nutty and sweet.
method:
Toast the bread.
Spread 1 tbsp peanut butter on each slice while warm.
Add 1 tbsp jelly on top and finish with banana slices.

title: Fried eggs on toast
blurb: Two eggs each, with toast and tomatoes.
method:
Toast the bread.
Heat a pan over medium-low heat and melt the butter.
Crack in the eggs and cook 3–4 min until the whites are set. Cover with a lid for 1 min for firmer yolks.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with toast and halved tomatoes.

title: Salmon, rice & broccoli
blurb: Crispy-skinned salmon with soy and lemon.
method:
Rinse the rice, add 225 ml water and a pinch of salt. Bring to a boil, cover and simmer on low 12 min, then rest 10 min off the heat.
Cut the broccoli into florets and steam 4–5 min.
Pat the salmon dry and season. Fry skin-side down in hot oil for 4 min, flip and cook 2–3 min more.
Drizzle the salmon with soy sauce and a squeeze of lemon. Serve with rice and broccoli.

title: Baked cod with potatoes & green beans
blurb: Oven-baked, light, with butter and dill.
method:
Heat the oven to 200°C. Halve the potatoes, toss with 1 tbsp oil and salt and roast 30 min.
After 16 min, add the cod to the tray. Brush with oil, season and lay lemon slices on top. Bake 12–14 min until it flakes.
Boil the green beans 4 min, drain and toss with butter.
Serve with chopped dill and a squeeze of lemon.

title: Chicken thighs, rice & fresh salad
blurb: Paprika chicken with cucumber and tomato.
method:
Cook the rice (see salmon recipe, step 1).
Rub the chicken with paprika, garlic, salt and pepper.
Fry in oil over medium-high heat 6 min, flip and cook 5–6 min more until cooked through (75°C inside). Rest 3 min.
Chop cucumber and tomatoes, dress with olive oil, vinegar and salt. Serve together.

title: Chicken & vegetable stir-fry
blurb: Quick wok dinner with a soy-honey glaze.
method:
Cook the rice.
Toss the chicken with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the cornstarch.
Stir-fry the chicken in hot oil 4–5 min until golden. Take it out.
Stir-fry carrot, pepper and snap peas 3 min. Add garlic and ginger for 30 sec.
Return the chicken, add remaining soy sauce and honey, toss 1 min. Serve over rice.

title: Beef & pepper stir-fry
blurb: Seared strips, peppers, spring onion.
method:
Cook the rice.
Toss the beef with 1 tbsp soy sauce and the cornstarch.
Sear the beef in a very hot pan in one layer, 1–2 min. Take it out.
Stir-fry onion and peppers 3 min, add garlic, then the beef and remaining soy sauce. Toss 1 min.
Top with sliced spring onion and serve with rice.

title: Steak with roasted vegetables
blurb: Pan-seared steak, tray-roasted veg.

ingredients.name: Steaks (sirloin or ribeye, about 200 g each)

method:
Heat the oven to 200°C. Chop the vegetables, toss with oil and salt and roast 25 min.
Take the steaks out of the fridge 20 min before cooking. Pat dry and salt well.
Sear in a very hot pan 3 min per side for medium-rare. Add butter and garlic for the last minute and baste.
Rest the steaks 5 min, slice and serve with the vegetables.

title: Beef tacos
blurb: Spiced beef, crisp toppings, lime.
method:
Fry the onion 4 min, add the beef and brown it, breaking it up.
Add garlic, taco spice and tomato paste, stir 1 min, then add 100 ml water and simmer 5 min.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan or the oven.
Fill with beef and top with lettuce, tomato, avocado, cheese, sour cream and lime.

title: Homemade burgers
blurb: Juicy patties with oven fries.
method:
Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut the potatoes into fries, toss with oil and salt and bake 25–30 min, turning once.
Shape two patties slightly wider than the buns and press a dimple in the middle.
Salt and pepper just before cooking. Sear in a hot pan 3–4 min per side. Add cheese for the last minute with a lid on.
Toast the buns, spread the sauce and build: lettuce, patty, tomato, onion, pickles.

title: Chicken fajitas
blurb: Sizzling chicken and peppers, wrap your own.
method:
Toss the chicken with fajita spice, a squeeze of lime and 1 tbsp oil.
Cook the chicken in a hot pan 5–6 min until done. Take it out.
Fry the peppers and onion 4–5 min until soft with some char, then return the chicken.
Serve in warm tortillas with sour cream, salsa and lime.

title: Overnight oats with berries
blurb: Made the night before, ready when you wake up.
method:
In the evening, mix oats, milk, yogurt, chia and honey and split between two jars.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours.
In the morning, stir, loosen with a splash of milk if thick, and top with berries and banana.

title: Greek yogurt bowl
blurb: Creamy yogurt, fruit, crunch and a little honey.
method:
Spoon the yogurt into two bowls.
Top with banana, berries, granola and nuts.
Drizzle with honey.

title: Avocado toast with poached egg
blurb: Sourdough, smashed avocado, runny egg.
method:
Bring a small pan of water to a gentle simmer and add the vinegar.
Toast the bread. Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Stir the water into a slow swirl, crack in the eggs one at a time and poach 3 min. Lift out with a slotted spoon.
Spread the avocado on the toast, top with an egg and a pinch of chilli flakes.

title: Veggie omelette
blurb: Spinach, pepper, tomato and feta.
method:
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat and soften the pepper 2 min. Add spinach and tomatoes for 30 sec.
Pour in the eggs and cook on low 3 min, lifting the edges so the raw egg runs under.
Crumble over the feta, fold in half and cut in two.

title: Scrambled eggs & smoked salmon on rye
blurb: Soft eggs, salmon and dill on dark rye.
method:
Whisk the eggs with milk and a pinch of salt.
Melt the butter over low heat, add the eggs and stir gently for 3–4 min until just set.
Pile onto the rye with the salmon, dill and black pepper.

title: Fluffy pancakes with berries
blurb: Thick American-style stack with syrup.
method:
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
Whisk the egg, milk and melted butter, pour into the dry mix and stir until just combined. Small lumps are fine.
Heat a lightly buttered pan over medium heat. Add 3 tbsp batter per pancake and cook until bubbles appear, about 2 min, then flip for 1 min.
Stack and serve with berries and syrup.

title: French toast
blurb: Cinnamon-egg bread, golden in butter.
method:
Whisk eggs, milk, cinnamon and vanilla sugar in a wide dish.
Soak each slice for 10–15 sec per side.
Fry in butter over medium heat, 2–3 min per side until golden.
Serve with berries and syrup or a dusting of icing sugar.

title: Shakshuka
blurb: Eggs poached in spiced tomato sauce. A weekend pan.
method:
Soften the onion and pepper in oil over medium heat for 6–7 min.
Add garlic, cumin and paprika for 1 min, then the tomatoes. Simmer 8 min until thick. Season.
Make four hollows, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 5–7 min until the whites set.
Top with feta and parsley and serve from the pan with bread.

title: Glazed salmon rice bowl
blurb: Soy-honey salmon, edamame, cucumber, avocado.
method:
Cook the rice.
Mix soy sauce, sesame oil and honey.
Sear the salmon cubes in a hot pan 3–4 min, then add half the sauce and toss until glazed.
Boil the edamame 3 min. Slice the cucumber and avocado.
Build the bowls, drizzle over the rest of the sauce and add sesame and spring onion.

title: Oven fish & chips
blurb: Crunchy panko cod, chips, peas and tartare.
method:
Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut the potatoes into chips, toss with oil and salt and bake 30–35 min, turning once.
Season the cod. Dip in flour, then egg, then panko mixed with paprika.
Bake the fish on an oiled tray for the last 15 min of the chips.
Boil the peas 3 min. Stir together the tartare. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Creamy salmon pasta
blurb: Lemony cream sauce with spinach.
method:
Cook the pasta. Keep a cup of the water.
Sear the salmon in a little oil 3 min. Add garlic for 30 sec.
Pour in the cream, bring to a simmer and stir in the spinach until wilted.
Toss with the pasta, lemon and parmesan, loosening with pasta water. Finish with pepper.

title: Coconut fish curry
blurb: Mild, fragrant curry with white fish and rice.

ingredients.name: Cod or other white fish, in chunks

method:
Cook the rice.
Soften the onion 5 min. Add garlic, ginger and curry paste and fry 1 min.
Add coconut milk and pepper and simmer 8 min.
Add the fish and simmer gently 5 min without stirring much. Stir in the spinach.
Finish with lime juice and coriander and serve with the rice.

title: Chicken Caesar salad
blurb: Crisp romaine with a lighter yogurt dressing.
method:
Season and pan-fry the chicken 5–6 min per side until cooked through. Rest, then slice.
Cube the bread, toss with a little oil and toast in the pan until crisp.
Whisk yogurt, mayo, mustard, garlic, lemon and Worcestershire into a dressing.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing, then top with chicken, croutons and shaved parmesan.

title: Chicken souvlaki with tzatziki
blurb: Lemon-oregano skewers, Greek salad, pita.
method:
Marinate the chicken in oil, lemon juice, oregano, 1 garlic clove and salt for at least 15 min.
Thread onto skewers and cook in a hot grill pan 10–12 min, turning, until cooked through.
Mix yogurt, grated cucumber, remaining garlic, salt and dill for the tzatziki.
Serve with a chopped salad and warm pita.

title: Chicken & sweet potato tray bake
blurb: One tray, very little washing up.
method:
Heat the oven to 210°C.
Toss the sweet potato with oil, paprika, thyme and salt on a tray. Add the chicken, season, and roast 25 min.
Add pepper, onion and broccoli and roast 12–15 min more until the chicken is cooked through (75°C).

title: Chicken noodle soup
blurb: Clear broth, soft noodles, lots of vegetables.
method:
Soften onion, carrot and celery in a little oil for 5 min. Add garlic.
Add the stock and whole chicken, bring to a simmer and cook 15 min.
Lift out the chicken and shred it. Add the noodles to the pot for 4 min.
Return the chicken, season, and finish with parsley and a squeeze of lemon.

title: Butter chicken
blurb: Rich tomato-cream curry with rice and naan.
method:
Marinate the chicken with yogurt, 1 tsp garam masala, turmeric and salt for 15 min or more.
Cook the rice.
Fry the chicken in 1 tbsp butter until browned. Take it out.
Soften the onion in the rest of the butter, add garlic, ginger and remaining garam masala, then the tomatoes. Simmer 10 min and blend if you like it smooth.
Stir in the cream and chicken and simmer 8 min. Serve with rice, naan and coriander.

title: Spaghetti bolognese
blurb: Slow-simmered meat sauce, parmesan on top.
method:
Finely chop onion, carrot and celery and soften in oil 8 min.
Add the beef and brown well. Add garlic and tomato paste for 1 min.
Add tomatoes, oregano and 100 ml water. Simmer 25 min, stirring now and then.
Cook the spaghetti, toss with the sauce and top with parmesan and basil.

title: Chili con carne
blurb: Smoky beef and beans with rice.
method:
Soften onion and pepper 5 min. Add the beef and brown.
Add garlic, spices and tomato paste for 1 min, then tomatoes and beans.
Simmer 25 min until thick. Cook the rice meanwhile.
Serve with sour cream, grated cheddar and spring onion.

title: Meatballs with mash & gravy
blurb: Nordic-style, with lingonberry jam.
method:
Boil the potatoes 18–20 min, then mash with warm milk, butter and salt.
Mix beef, egg, breadcrumbs, onion, allspice, salt and pepper and roll into walnut-size balls.
Fry the meatballs 8–10 min, turning, until browned and cooked through. Set aside.
In the same pan, cook butter and flour 1 min, whisk in the stock and simmer 3 min. Return the meatballs.
Boil the beans 4 min. Serve with mash, gravy and lingonberry.

title: Beef burrito bowl
blurb: Lean spiced beef, beans, corn, fresh salsa.
method:
Cook the rice.
Brown the beef with the spices and a pinch of salt, 6–8 min.
Warm the beans and corn.
Dice tomato and red onion, mix with lime juice and coriander for a quick salsa.
Build the bowls with rice, beef, beans, corn, salsa, avocado and a spoon of yogurt.

title: Steak salad
blurb: Sliced sirloin over crunchy leaves.
method:
Bring the steak to room temperature, pat dry and salt well.
Sear in a very hot pan 3 min per side for medium-rare. Rest 5 min, then slice thinly.
Whisk oil, balsamic, mustard and honey.
Toss the leaves, tomatoes, cucumber and onion with the dressing. Top with steak and crumbled feta.

title: Coffee for two
blurb: French press, every morning.
method:
Warm the press with hot water and pour it out.
Add the coffee and pour in the water. Stir once.
Put the lid on and steep 4 min.
Press slowly and pour right away.
